findings.location: src/core/externalTaskBridge.ts:487 (SET LOCAL choros.tenant_id via string interpolation)
findings.issue: tenantId is interpolated directly into a SET LOCAL statement (quote-escaped) rather than passed as a bind parameter, because Postgres SET does not support parameterized values. Safe here ONLY because tenantId is validated against UUID_RE before this point (line ~467) — an unvalidated string would be an injection vector.
findings.suggestion: No action needed now — this mirrors the exact pre-existing pattern in agent-dispatch-loop.ts:314/424 and lifecycle-bridge.ts:185, and the UUID guard is confirmed present before use. Flagging only so a future refactor of the UUID guard doesn't accidentally weaken this shared pattern across all three call sites at once.

findings.issue: String(err) on a per-tenant enqueue failure could in theory include verbose driver/db error detail (not secrets — no code path constructs an Error containing the Flowable password or Authorization header — but e.g. a raw SQL fragment on a constraint violation). Not a blocking secret leak (verified: flowable-client.ts never throws an Error containing `auth`/password; the only literal throw is the missing-password guard in makeFlowableClient, which is unreachable here since both composition roots noop-degrade before calling it).
findings.suggestion: Optional hardening for a follow-up: truncate/allowlist the err message before logging, or log err.message only. Not required for this task's acceptance criteria (NF-6 explicitly scopes 'password/Authorization', which is satisfied).
